generation.scope: The entire normalized one-sided marked solution locus with smooth determinant, including every inverse commutator sheet, is irreducible of dimension 27, with indexed class image dimension fourteen in the known fifteen-dimensional component. For each fixed nonexceptional metric-cubic pair all lifts form one irreducible eighteen-dimensional presentation locus, including the commuting special nets, and its generic window is AS. For a fixed exceptional pair there are exactly four irreducible eighteen-dimensional presentation components labeled by order-four auxiliary classes. Regularity on those fixed exceptional components remains to be decided.

open_mathematics: Extend the linear symmetrizer and fixed-target adjugate formulas to integral singular cubic determinants via the normalization and the noninvertible rank-one sheaf. Start with the nodal cubic xyz=y^3+z^3 and distinguish the singular-point ranks of the target and auxiliary representations.
